summary: Adversarial Stage B review of the D-275 COORD draft, run to refute. Twenty-five attacks were framed against the draft's custody, digests, branch arithmetic, Stage A fidelity, currency qualifiers, obligation partition and readiness recitals. All twenty-five were refuted on live bytes. The subject was measured at 85c07ba5… with mode 0444 at both the open and the close of the review and did not move. All eleven Measured-inputs digests matched. The branch enumeration matches the specification exactly, excludes D-236 and carries D-272 only as an explicit CONTESTED exclusion. The Stage A disposition reports both reviewers accurately, invents no identifier and claims preservation for neither. leftoverDesign matches the subject artifact's own partition. The strongest candidate defect — that the phrase 'recites those Claude observations as strings' promises a verbatim reproduction the draft never performs — was defeated by adopted precedent in which the identical sentence carries count and type without quoting bytes. Three residual observations are recorded, none of which is a finding: the frozen subject artifact's stale internal reviewStatus, a cosmetic path-formatting inconsistency, and predecessor occupancy-v2 lineage retained in basedOn. No MUST-FIX. No SHOULD-FIX.
